question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

The state of being unmarried by choice
solution:
The correct answer is 'Celibacy.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us discuss the **meanings **of the given options:

 
 
• Isolation: the state of being separate and alone; the act of separating somebody/something. (अलग और अकेला होने की स्थिति, अलगाव; किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को अलग करने का कार्य; पृथक्‍करण)
 
• **Monogamy**: the fact or custom of being married to only one person at a particular time. (एक समय में केवल एक व्‍यक्ति से विवाह और उसकी प्रथा, एकविवाह प्रथा)
 
• **Celibacy**: the state of intentionally not being married. (ब्रह्मचर्य)
 
• **Polygamy**: the custom of having more than one wife at the same time. (बहुपत्‍नी प्रथा)
 
 
 
• Therefore, the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words is **Celibacy.**
